modern_pos_endpoints.details: All modern /api/dewi/maklon/pos endpoints working perfectly. GET list returns POs with correct shape (items[], po_number, total_qty, total_value, status). GET detail includes enrichment fields (dispatches, material_receives, bom). POST confirm creates WOs and AR invoices. POST cancel works correctly.

legacy_orders_endpoints.details: Legacy /api/dewi/maklon/orders endpoints work via _MaklonOrdersView wrapper. Returns legacy shape with _source='dewi_maklon_pos' marker confirming data comes from new SSOT. All legacy fields present (order_code, stage_qty, linked_wo_ids, etc.).

legacy_production_endpoints.details: Legacy production-detail endpoint works (supports stage_qty workflow for MaklonProductionTracking). Material-issues endpoint works (supports MaklonMaterialIssuePanel).

accessory_module.details: Accessory module endpoints work from rahaza_materials SSOT. Create, list, and stock receive all functional.

toko_module.details: Toko module endpoints work via wrappers (marketing_* backed). Product create, list, and order list all functional.

database_verification.details: Legacy wrapper correctly uses dewi_maklon_pos collection (not dewi_maklon_orders). Source marker '_source: dewi_maklon_pos' present in all legacy endpoint responses. This confirms dewi_maklon_orders collection is not being used.
